findings.description: Existence assertion followed by write_text does not reserve the receipt. A dangling symlink passes exists() and write_text creates its target; a creator between check/write is overwritten. Exact pathlib sequence independently reproduced in isolated temporary paths.

Do not silently change the active gate process; retain which helper generated its receipt.
